summary.ru: Тайфа Сарагоса — средневековый мусульманский эмират на востоке современной Испании, существовавшее в 1013—1110 годах. Столица — город Сарагоса.
summary.en: The taifa of Zaragoza was an independent Arab Muslim state in the east of Al-Andalus with its capital in Saraqusta city. It was established in the early 11th century as one of the many Taifa kingdoms that followed the collapse of the Caliphate of Córdoba around this time. It survived until 1110, when it was annexed by the Almoravids.
